description_en: The Balaṃpū Priest House (locally known as ‘Balaṃpūchẽ’) stands on the backside of the Mādhava Nārāyaṇa Dyaḥchẽ (SKH0100) at a place called Vāphalcā in the Sālkhā Ṭola, Sankhu. The term ‘balaṃpū’ is derivative of the Sanskrit term ‘brahmapura’. Being the residence of the Rājopādhyāya brahmins who officiate the daily rituals at the shrine of Mādhava Nārāyaṇa, the Building is referred to as Balaṃpū Priest House. The Rājopādhyāyas of the Paṭako Ṭola, Patan reside here. They originally hailed from the hillock of Maṇicūḍa, where 10 families of Rājopādhyāyas resided. Two of them migrated to Bhaktapur, two other families moved to Kathmandu, and the remaining six had settled in various localities of Patan. These 10 families of Rājopādhyāyas later developed into the 10 clans of the Newar Hindu priests. While the 10 families divided among themselves the cities where they would officiate as priests, the head of the two families who moved to Bhaktapur were assigned as priests of Dolakha, Sankhu, and Changu. Later, each head of the two families further divided one of the three cities each among their three sons. One of them remained in Bhaktapur and continued to serve as the priest at the temple of Cā̃gunārāyaṇa. The other two again moved from Bhaktapur to Nhāykaṃtalā in Kathmandu with one of them carrying out the priestly functions at Dolakhā while the other serving as the priest of Sankhu. Meanwhile, the priest of Sankhu started living at his maternal uncle’s home at Paṭako in Patan. Hence, his descendants at Paṭako still reserve the right to serve as a priest at various shrines of Sankhu.The history behind the initial construction of the Balaṃpū Priest House is unclear due to the unavailability of inscriptive sources. However, a manuscript record shows that a Brahmin of Brahmapurī (text: Brahmapuli) in Sankhu went through the initiation ritual in 1682 CE (NS 802) (Regmipart 3, 1966, Thyāsaphū A, p. 19). This ascertains the fact that the Balaṃpū Priest House was constructed before1682 CE. As the condition of this monument deteriorated, the priests began to live in their private houses. In the 2015 earthquakes, the roof of the Priest House collapsed. Without timely and proper renovation, it is now (December 2021) reduced to rubble after failing to survive years of sun and rain. The Shankharapur Municipality has commenced the reconstruction of the House. They started digging the foundation in December 2021.No religious and cultural activities take place here, as the House was constructed as the residence of the priest of Mādhava Nārāyaṇa.
description_ne: साँखुको साल्खा टोलमा वाफल्चा भन्ने ठाउँमा माधव नारायणको द्यःछेँ (SKH0100) रहेको छ । द्यःछेँको पछाडिपट्टि माधव नारायणको पूजारीको निवास रहेको छ । सर्वसाधारणहरू यस घरलाई बलंपूछेँ भन्ने गर्छन् । ब्राह्मणहरूको निवास जनाउने संस्कृत शब्दब्रह्मपुरबाट अपभ्रंश भएरबलंपूबनेको हो । माधव नारायणको पूजा गर्ने राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणहरूको निवास हुनाले यस घरलाई बलंपू  पूजारीघर भनिएको हो । यस घरमा ललितपुरको पटको टोलमा बस्ने राजोपाध्याय पूजारीहरू बस्छन् । राजोपाध्यायहरूको पहिलो बासस्थान मणिचूड डाँडा थियो । त्यहाँ राजोपाध्यायहरूका १० वटा खलक थिए । ती १० खलकमध्ये दुईवटा खलक भक्तपुरमा, दुईवटा खलक काठमाडौंमा र छवटा खलक ललितपुरमा बसाइँ सरेका थिए । ती १० वटा खलकले पूजारी हुने र पुरोहित्याइँ गर्ने भागबण्डा गर्दा भक्तपुरमा बस्नेले दोलखा, साँखु र चाँगुको अधिकार पाएका थिए । उनले तीनजना छोरालाई तीन ठाउँको पूजारी हुने र पुरोहित्याइँको अधिकार बाँडिदिए । ती तीनजनामध्ये एकजनाले भक्तपुमै बसी चाँगुनारायणको पूजा गरिरहे । बाँकी दुईजना काठमाडौंको न्हाय्‌कंतलामा गएर बसेका थिए । न्हाय्‌कंतलामा बसेका दुईजनामध्ये एकजनाले दोलखाको पूजा गरिरहे भने साँखुको पूजाको अधिकार पाएको व्यक्ति मावलीघर ललितपुरको पटकोमा आएर बसेका थिए । यसप्रकार साँखुको पूजारी र पुरोहित्याइँको अधिकार ललितपुरको पटकोमा बस्ने राजोपाध्यायले पाएका थिए ।यो घरको निर्माणबारे ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण पाइएको छैन । नेसं ८०२ (सन् १६८२) को एउटा घटनावलीमा साँखुको ब्रह्मपुलि (ब्रह्मपुरी) बस्ने ब्राह्मणको व्रतबन्ध गरिएको कुरा टिपिएको छ । यस घटनाबाट बलंपू  पूजारीघर नेसं ८०२ मा नै अस्तित्वमा आइसकेको प्रमाणित हुन्छ । घर पुरानो भएपछि पूजारीहरू यस घरमा नबसी आफ्नै निजी घरमा गएर बस्न थालेका थिए । विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को भूकम्पले यो घरको छाना भत्किएको थियो । तर छानाको मर्मत गर्ने काममा बेवास्ता गरिएको हुनाले वर्षौंको घामपानीले घर भत्केर पाताल भएको थियो । शंखरापुर नगरपालिकाले पूजारीघरको पुनर्निर्माणको काम अगाडि बढाएको छ । विसं २०७८ पुष महिना (सन् २०२१) मा पूजारीघर पुनर्निर्माणको लागि जग खनिएको छ ।यस घर माधव नारायणको पूजारी बस्नको लागि निर्माण गरिएकोले यहाँ कुनै धार्मिक-सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि हुँदैन ।

historical_events.event_name: Mention of the Balaṃpū Priest House
historical_events.event_description: A manuscript record shows that a Brahmin of Brahmapurī (text: Brahmapuli) in Sankhu went through the initiation ritual, stretching its history back to the late medieval period.
After its roof collapsed in the 2015 earthquakes, the Priest House remained in a state of disrepair and was reduced to rubble after failing to survive years of sun and rain.
The Shankharapur Municipality has recently started (as of December 2021) reconstruction of this monument.
